case_note: Diameter 45 mm, black ceramic with removable wire loop strap attachments (patented) in steel with special hard black coating. Winding crown in ceramic personalised OP.
case_back: Screw, steel with special hard black coating.
dial: Black with luminous Arabic numerals and hour markers. Seconds at 9 o’clock.
crystal: Sapphire, formed of corundum, 2.2 mm thick. Anti-reflective coating.
movement_note: Hand-wound mechanical, exclusive Panerai OP XI calibre, 16½ lignes, 17 jewels, Glucydur® Balance, 21,600 alternations/hour. Incabloc® anti-shock device. Swan’s neck regulator. Power reserve 56 hours. Côtes de Genève decoration on the bridges.
bracelet: PANERAI personalised leather strap and large-size brushed steel buckle with special hard black coating.
